albums.about: Theme songs and anthems from HQ.

songs.title: Operation Countdown
songs.about: The opening briefing. Staccato strings, brass stabs, and a clock that will not stop.

songs.title: Operation Fuse
songs.about: The fuse is lit. Brass and a bass line that will not sit still.

songs.title: Operation Riptide
songs.about: Surf guitar on the night shift. Twang, reverb, and full speed.

songs.title: Operation Undertow
songs.about: The surf rock file, pulled deeper. Tremolo guitar and big brass.

songs.title: Operation Night Watch
songs.about: A lo-fi stakeout. Muted trumpet, soft rain, and a long night.

songs.title: Operation Cold Coffee
songs.about: Still on the stakeout. Quiet piano and a coffee gone cold.

songs.title: Operation Slapback
songs.about: Slap bass and electronic drums. The chase is on.

songs.title: Operation Drop Zone
songs.about: Risers, then the drop. Full brass and bass to close the file.

songs.title: Wiretap
songs.about: The newest HQ intro. Part of the broadcast rotation.

songs.title: Glass Alibi
songs.about: One of the HQ intros in the broadcast rotation.

songs.title: Dead Drop
songs.about: One of the HQ intros in the broadcast rotation.

songs.title: Chrome Cipher
songs.about: One of the HQ intros in the broadcast rotation.

songs.title: Black Tie
songs.about: The title track. Twangy guitar, big brass, and a bow tie pulled tight.

songs.title: Silver Fox
songs.about: Cool, calm, and one step ahead. Low guitar and soaring horns.

songs.title: High Roller
songs.about: Big band swing at the casino table. Muted trumpets and a sly guitar.

songs.title: Last Call
songs.about: The lounge is closing. Warm saxophone and one last brass hit.

songs.title: Fast Exit
songs.about: Neon lights and a getaway. Synth bass and a racing beat.

songs.title: Red Light Run
songs.about: No stopping now. Driving synths and a twangy lead.

songs.title: Zero Hour
songs.about: The clock runs out. Ticking strings, then huge drums and booming brass.

songs.title: Shockwave
songs.about: The final blast. Orchestral hits and brass to close the night.

songs.title: Tiptoe
songs.about: The opening creep. Breathy saxophone and a walking bass, one careful step at a time.

songs.title: Velvet Rope
songs.about: Past the rope and into the gallery. Soft brushes and a slinky sax.

songs.title: Near Miss
songs.about: Plucked strings tiptoe, then a brass sting. That was close.

songs.title: Butterfingers
songs.about: Clarinet, bassoon, and one clumsy step too many.

songs.title: Moonlit Terrace
songs.about: A rooftop party after dark. Nylon guitar, breathy flute, and a sly sax.

songs.title: Slow Dance
songs.about: Cool and unhurried. Vibraphone and a gentle sway.

songs.title: Quick Change
songs.about: Swing brass over a modern beat. A new disguise in every bar.

songs.title: Back Door
songs.about: The sax slips out quietly, then the beat drops back in.

songs.title: Island Patrol
songs.about: The title track. Pounding drums and a big brass fanfare across open water.

songs.title: Harbor Run
songs.about: Racing the boats to the dock. Fast strings and punchy brass.

songs.title: Tiki Torch
songs.about: Vibraphone and slide guitar in a tiki lounge after dark.

songs.title: Palm Shade
songs.about: Bongos, ukulele, and distant birds. A slow island stakeout.

songs.title: Breakwater
songs.about: Rapid breakbeats and soaring horns, from the rooftops to the harbor.

songs.title: Pier Pressure
songs.about: Deep bass, brass stabs, and nowhere left to run.

songs.title: Drum Major
songs.about: Snares and quad toms lead the squad into the stadium.

songs.title: Full Formation
songs.about: The whole band hits at once. A big drum roll and one last blast.

songs.title: Cold Case
songs.about: The title track. Electric piano, a steady bass line, and a mournful clarinet.

songs.title: Late Shift
songs.about: Still at the desk after midnight. Low piano and quiet tension.

songs.title: Closing Argument
songs.about: A string quartet makes its case. Plucked cello and trading violins.

songs.title: Hung Jury
songs.about: No verdict yet. Tense strings that build, then settle on one held note.

songs.title: Two-Way Mirror
songs.about: Wailing harmonica in the interrogation room. Someone is watching.

songs.title: No Comment
songs.about: A slow shuffle and bent guitar notes. The suspect is not talking.

songs.title: Paper Trail
songs.about: Clicky beats and data blips. The evidence starts to line up.

songs.title: Fingerprint
songs.about: Scanning sweeps and a cool electric piano. A match comes back.

songs.title: Belle's Takeover
songs.about: Belle's theme song. She runs the show.

songs.title: Raid on HQ
songs.about: Plays when a raid lands at HQ.

songs.title: Sealed In
songs.about: Welcome to the fold. Once you're in, you're in.
